# Contribution notes

This repository records an early project concept and is not the active Galilea website. Please make functional changes in the maintained repositories linked from the README.

For documentation changes:
- Keep project status, dates, and external links accurate.
- Prefer concise explanations over promotional claims.
- Preserve existing credits and ownership details.
- Check Markdown links and describe what was reviewed in the pull request.

No automated test suite is configured for this historical repository.
